events.title: Playtest and Demo
events.summary: We have concluded the current playtest. Thank you to everyone who participated and shared their feedback—it was incredibly helpful!We are currently preparing a demo version for release and getting ready to participate in Steam Next Fest. We’ve updated the page’s visuals and description and temporarily removed the old trailer; we’ll be announcing a new trailer for the demo soon.

events.title: 1000 Wishlists!
events.summary: We've reached the 1,000+ wishlists, and it's all thanks to you! Thank you for your support and belief in CUP OR DIE!At the moment we are working very hard on the game and preparing for playtest and further demo version.

events.title: Registration for the Playtest is open!
events.summary: Hello everyone!Playtest registration is open!We're currently working on an early version, which we plan to release for playtesting.We'd love for you to join us and help us test and improve!Thank you all for your support!

events.title: The Store Page is Live! Welcome to the Mysterious Bar!
events.summary: Hello everyone!I am excited to announce that the Steam store page for Cup Or Die is finally live.I'm creating a dark, atmospheric horror action strategy game with roguelite elements. The very first mechanics have already been implemented and shown in the teaser, and I'm actively working on further content.
